name: Sairaj Bandre
summary: AI-focused Computer Science postgraduate (B.E. in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science) with hands-on experience building AI agent workflows, automation and data pipelines in production, plus deep learning, computer vision and NLP projects. Two published research papers.

experience.role: Executive, Supply Chain Management & Automation Operations

Solved a hard integration gap by building RPA-driven automation for Amazon Seller Central workflows not covered by the SP-API, removing manual handling of high-volume processes.
Debugged, optimised and scaled automation systems with cross-functional teams, quickly learning unfamiliar codebases to improve reliability and performance.
experience.summary: Built and ran live automation, SQL reporting tools and RPA for high-volume e-commerce operations, including the workflows no official API covered.
